treasure_purpose: Provide usable combat and exploration tools.
Determine secondary placement by total recovered value.
Offer trade and betrayal opportunities in Work Separately.
chest_states: Mimic or magical decoy in expanded content

encumbrance_modes.story: Only large quest objects use carrying limits.
encumbrance_modes.standard: Weight affects movement after a generous threshold.
encumbrance_modes.strict: Full inventory weight and container management.

records.name: Healing potions
records.activation: Action or Bonus Action in quick-use mode

records.name: Potion of Energy
records.effect: Recover one expended limited-power use, maximum once per Game Level

records.name: Wand of Magic Missile
records.effect: Spend 1 charge to create three darts, each dealing 1d4 + 1 force; 7 charges, regain 1d6+1 at dawn

records.name: Wand of Delay Poison
records.effect: Suppress Poisoned and ongoing poison damage on one creature for 10 minutes

records.name: Ring of Improved Jumping
records.effect: Triple jump distance and ignore the first 10 feet of falling damage

records.name: Ring of Invisibility
records.effect: Become Invisible for up to 1 minute; once per long rest or once per mystery

records.name: Brain Serum
records.effect: Gain Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks for 10 minutes; after it ends, make DC 12 Constitution save or become Stunned until end of next turn

records.name: Targeting Array
records.effect: Gain Advantage on the next ranged attack before end of turn

records.name: Lockpicks
records.effect: Enable Dexterity checks with Thieves’ Tools to open locks and disarm mechanisms

records.name: Rations
records.effect: One ration prevents a storm-rest penalty for one hero

records.name: Rope, nets, grappling hooks, and portable ram
records.effect: Supports climbing, restraint, rescue, forced doors, pit recovery, and environmental counterplay

records.name: Evidence Card
records.effect: Excludes one suspect, weapon, or room from the sealed solution. Visibility follows the selected playstyle.
records.tradeable: Only when the lobby explicitly allows evidence trading; the server retains ownership history.

records.name: Case Notebook
records.effect: Tracks exclusions, possibilities, player holdings, unresolved sets, timeline notes, and evidence sources.
